content: Akanksha Bhatt called insurance agent Suresh Deshmukh to check the status of her pre-authorization. Suresh confirmed the form is in final review and will be completed by tomorrow. He instructed Akanksha to sign the consent form digitally via the portal (https://portal.dcoders.com) and clarified that the MRI co-pay is 10% after the ₹2,000 deductible, payable at the imaging center.

action_items: Suresh to email the direct portal link to Akanksha
Akanksha to sign the consent form digitally in the portal
